fields.value: Reference policies by name with PolicyKey, and pool their results across experiments

Part of the EXP-66 stream, stacked on PR #113. Today a checkpoint's key is its run and file name without the experiment, so two experiments' base@0 collide, an eval's results belong only to the experiment that played them, and relative seats cannot reach another experiment's runs.

Outcome: PolicyKey(experiment, job, seed, role) names exactly one policy with every part defaultable (this experiment; the only job; the lowest seed; the only role); seats select by experiment/job/seed/role or take a key, with no seed meaning every seed; checkpoint, player and result identity include experiment and role, so results pool across experiments; EvalJob(experiment=) is deleted.

Jack Heart, 2026-11-14: "i think there should be some way to reference policies basically by name"; "i think maybe we want a small multi-part object with like experiment, run, role, seed"; "and all reasonable defaults"; "as the policy key"; "ok, i agree with lowest". Full quotes and design: scratch/policy-keys.md in the Task checkout. No rental, no release; not merged or armed.
